name: autofocus
label: Autofocus
description: Causes the component to receive focus as soon as it has finished mounting

name: defaultZeros
label: Default zeros
description: When true, the time field will always default to 00:00:00 when empty

name: format
label: Format
description: How to serialize/deserialize the date value

name: separator
label: Separator
description: What the user sees between each time unit

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: Specifies whether the current value is not valid

name: label
label: Label
description: All form controls need a label

name: name
label: Name
description: Any events dispatched by the component will use this name

name: readonly
label: Read only
description: Specifies that the user cannot modify the value of the component

name: required
label: Required
description: Whether or not the user must fill in a value for this component

name: relativeTime
label: Relative time
description: When true, this component will not update the default time values. Used with TimeAgo Presets like 'Last 15 minutes'

name: reversed
label: Reversed
description: When true, this component will not update the default time values. Used with TimeAgo Presets like 'Last 15 minutes'

name: use24Hour
label: Use 24-hour
description: When true, this component uses 24-hour based notation rather than 12-hour

name: helperContent
label: Helper content
description: If set, an iconic button with a popover appears next to the field label to display additional hint text to the user
